phase_name: Extraction Pass 2 -- First Fully Observed Pass

objectives.description: Confirm at least 24 hours since Pass-1 timestamp
Capture sapience coverage/pending BEFORE the pass
Run the pass via systemctl --user start sapience-sync.service, record start time
Bounded poll to completion (ActiveState settled to inactive at 22min 29.8s, well under the 60-minute cap)
Read journal: wall clock, chunk count, objects staged, redaction/set-aside, every extract error line
Capture sapience coverage/pending AFTER the pass
Append Pass-2 block with computed deltas
Re-check cost-signal availability (sapience stats re-run, confirms Phase 1 finding unchanged)
Record issue via issue-record.sh for the non-zero extract-error count

deviations.description: Bounded-poll wait for the sapience-sync unit to settle
deviations.reason: First poll loop checked `systemctl --user is-active --quiet` (matches only ActiveState==active) and returned a false DONE after ~2.5 minutes, because a Type=oneshot unit reports ActiveState=activating/SubState=start while its main process is still running -- it never transitions through 'active' at all. Corrected by polling ActiveState via `systemctl --user show -p ActiveState --value` and looping while the value is 'activating' or 'active', stopping only once it settles to something else (here 'inactive'). No data was lost: the correction was caught before any AFTER reading was taken.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered -- polling predicate corrected from is-active/--quiet to an explicit ActiveState check, since this unit holds ActiveState=activating while running)*

notes: Pass 2 recorded a non-zero extract-error count (34 lines, a transient network/DNS outage in the final ~2 minutes of the run), unlike Pass 1's 0 errors. Per the plan's risk mitigation this pass is flagged as unusable for the clean drain-rate computation and must be excluded or specially annotated in phase 7. 'would ingest now' held flat at 118 before and after despite 539 objects staged -- the first direct evidence on the drain question.
